name: Goa Beaches
description: Beautiful sandy beaches with water sports and vibrant nightlife. Family-friendly beaches like Candolim and Calangute offer safe swimming areas and amenities.
activities: Swimming, Water Sports, Beach Walks, Seafood

name: Shimla
description: Popular hill station with colonial architecture and scenic views. Mall Road offers shopping and dining. Safe for families with children.
activities: Toy Train, Mall Road Shopping, Ridge Walking, Nature Walks

name: Taj Mahal
description: Iconic marble monument and UNESCO World Heritage Site. Well-maintained gardens and facilities. Educational experience for children.

name: Jim Corbett National Park
description: India's oldest national park with diverse wildlife including tigers. Family-friendly safari zones with experienced guides.
activities: Jeep Safari, Bird Watching, Nature Walks, Wildlife Photography

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City with magnificent forts and palaces. Family-friendly attractions like Amber Fort with elephant rides and cultural shows.
activities: Fort Visits, Palace Tours, Shopping, Cultural Shows, Camel Rides

name: Munnar
description: Scenic hill station with tea plantations and misty mountains. Peaceful environment suitable for families. Cool climate year-round.
activities: Tea Estate Tours, Boating, Nature Walks, Photography

name: Hampi
description: Ancient ruins and temples showcasing Vijayanagara Empire architecture. UNESCO World Heritage Site with historical significance.
activities: Temple Tours, Ruins Exploration, Coracle Ride, Historical Learning

name: Andaman Islands
description: Pristine beaches with crystal clear waters and coral reefs. Havelock Island is family-friendly with safe beaches.
activities: Snorkeling, Scuba Diving, Beach Activities, Island Hopping

name: Rishikesh
description: Spiritual town on Ganges riverbank. Known for yoga and adventure sports. Mix of culture and nature.
activities: River Rafting, Yoga, Temple Visits, Beatles Ashram, Ganga Aarti

name: Ooty
description: Queen of hill stations with botanical gardens and toy train. Pleasant weather and family-friendly attractions.
activities: Botanical Gardens, Toy Train, Boating, Tea Gardens
